versions.changelog:
doubao-skill-v2 v0.1.1

- Added 9 sample media files (images and videos) to the data directory for testing and demonstration.
- Supports example outputs for image and video generation scenarios.
- No code or feature changes to scripts or core logic in this version.

Initial release with image generation, editing, and text-to-video capabilities via shell scripts.

- Added shell-based CLI for text-to-image, image editing, and text-to-video generation using Doubao (Volcengine ARK) API.
- Supports both synchronous and asynchronous video generation modes.
- Implements task status checking and automated file downloading to a data directory.
- Requires bash 4.0+, curl, (optional) jq, and ARK_API_KEY environment variable.
- Comprehensive documentation, usage examples, troubleshooting tips, and dependency installation guidance included.
